laws: Failure to observe through one sensing path does not prove entity absence
Observation must retain the sensing path/provider condition under which it was obtained
A borrowed external Sensor can widen an Agent's observable world without remote machine ownership
Discovery can expose Connector affordances without establishing a connection
Discovery evidence does not mint authority
limitations: No VPN Gate relay connection was attempted
No OpenVPN client was installed on the Host during this experiment
The experiment does not prove relay trust, future availability, throughput or destination reachability
The temporary Cloudflare Worker is experimental evidence, not a production Sensor provider
The observed public catalog is dynamic and point-in-time

productionDecision.reason: one live Sensor workload proves the missing discovery responsibility but not a stable shared production abstraction
